main_body: 2x1 grass terrain patch with small flowers
evidence: This is a flat horizontal ground terrain patch (2x1 tiles of grass with small pink and yellow flowers), which is appropriately drawn as a continuous top surface covering rows 0-15.

style.evidence: The grass uses only 3 green steps (mid base, one lighter highlight, one darker shade) plus 2-step flowers. Large patches (e.g. cols 3-8 rows 9-15, cols 11-16 rows 6-14) are single-colour flat green fills with sparse isolated pixel tufts, lacking the continuous multi-tone dithered/tufted richness of the Beodeul grass reference.
